excerpt.zh: [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的居民已经开始积极地寻找他们星球之外的智慧生命迹象。随着他们准备大胆地前往许多文明已经拜访过的地方时，可能我们是时候要重新评估我们的第一次接触协议了，做好准备，让更广泛的星海共同体迎接新的成员。

texts.zh: [pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的居民已经开始积极地寻找他们星球之外的智慧生命迹象。随着他们准备大胆地前往许多文明已经拜访过的地方时，可能我们是时候要重新评估我们的第一次接触协议了，做好准备，让更广泛的星海共同体迎接新的成员。
texts.en: The inhabitants of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have begun actively searching for signs of intelligent life beyond their world. As they prepare to boldly go where many have already gone, it may be time for us to reassess our first contact protocols, in preparation for a new addition to the wider galactic community.

label.zh: 当他们准备好时，我们会欢迎，但那之前还不行。
label.en: We will greet them when they are ready, and not before.

label.zh: 在恐惧中毁灭吧，你们这些小蠢蛋！
label.en: Quake with fear, you tiny fools!

texts.zh:
[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的[GetPreFTLLower]文明不知通过何种手段截取并破解了一段发自我们轨道观测站的通讯信号。

他们正在研究一份在观测站上的工作者发往我们首都的一位未知收信人的极具个性化的信息。

这一意外的泄露暴露了一处我们安保协议的漏洞。
texts.en:
The [GetPreFTLLower] civilization on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has somehow intercepted and deciphered a series of communications emanating from our orbital observation post.

They are currently studying a message of a very personal nature between an agent aboard the observation post, and an unknown recipient from our capital.

This unfortunate leak has highlighted gaps in our security protocols.

texts.zh:
[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上的[GetPreFTLLower]文明不知通过何种手段截取并破解了一段发自我们轨道观测站的通讯信号。

他们收到了我们的敏感信息。我们的安保存在漏洞。
texts.en:
The [GetPreFTLLower] civilization on [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] has somehow intercepted and deciphered a series of communications emanating from our orbital observation post.

They are in receipt of our sensitive data. We have gaps in our security.

label.en: We should have been more careful.

label.zh: 找到泄露源。遥控擦除他们的数据仓库。
label.en: Identify the leaks. Remotely scrub their data repository.

title.zh: 他们现在认为只剩自己了

texts.zh:
[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的居民搜寻智慧生命的努力一无所获。

他们投入了大量时间和资源在繁星中搜寻生命，但很沮丧地发现除了虚空以外一无所有。

目前这项研究还在进行，但可以肯定他们很快就对项目失去了希望。不必多说，我们将继续在每一个任务参数中对他们隐藏自身的存在。
texts.en:
The inhabitants of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have had no success in their search for intelligent life.

Having dedicated time and resources in the search for life amongst the stars, they were despondent to discover nothing but void.

For now, the search continues, but it is clear they are swiftly losing hope in the project. Needless to say, we will continue to hide our existence from them, per mission parameters.

label.zh: 他们还没准备好同我们会面。
label.en: They're not ready to meet us just yet.

texts.zh:
[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]上荒谬的居民们居然用他们羸弱的科技截获了一些我们过去的无线电信号。

解码和理解我们的广播足够让他们忙上几个世代。以他们目前的发展水平，我们尚且没有暴露的风险。
texts.en:
The ridiculous inhabitants of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] have used their weak tech to intercept some of our historic radio signals.

Deciphering and interpreting our old broadcasts should keep them busy for a few generations. With their current level of development, we are not at risk of being exposed.

texts.zh:
在他们搜寻外行星智慧的过程中，[pre_ftl_planet.GetName]的居民向整个星系发去了广播。他们收到的信息是，“嘘，别让他们听到了。”

这当然是我们一位特工的所作所为。结果是，这个年轻的太空民族现在正为外太空究竟蛰伏着什么恐怖动的东西而瑟瑟发抖。
texts.en:
In their search for extra-planetary intelligence, the inhabitants of [pre_ftl_planet.GetName] called out to the galaxy. What they received was a message which said, 'Be quiet or they will hear you.'

This was the action of one of our own agents. As a result, the young spacefarers are now terrified of what might lurk beyond their system.
